locations.note: Detective Joseph Kreiser works four murders across the Leipzig of 1899, from the theatre quarter to the working-class slums and an opium den; several of the scenes are reconstructions of real places in the city.
The first case: a factory owner drives his new automobile into the water in Plagwitz, and the villas of the industrial quarter hold the suspects.
The poor district of the game is the tenement streets of Lindenau.
The posh theatre and the square in front of it: in 1899 that is the Neues Theater on the Augustusplatz.
The Old Theatre of the last case, the city's original playhouse on the Fleischerplatz.

routes.name: Joseph Kreiser
routes.note: Four murders lead Kreiser from a car in the water at Plagwitz through the Lindenau slums and the opera stage, into the city's newspapers, cafes and opium dens, to the final killing at the Old Theatre.
